examples.en: The employment contract names the salary, the hours, and little else.
examples.zh: 雇佣合同写明了薪水、工时，别的几乎没写。

situation.en: Read the employment contract twice: once for what it promises, once for what it omits.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 雇佣合同

examples.en: A contractor agreement taxes you differently from an employment contract.
examples.zh: 承包商协议的纳税方式和雇佣合同不同。

situation.en: Under a contractor agreement, invoices replace payslips.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 承包商协议（以独立承包商身份签的合同）

examples.en: The non-disclosure agreement survives the end of the contract by two years.
examples.zh: 保密协议在合同结束后还有效两年。

situation.en: Sign the non-disclosure agreement before the technical deep dive, not after.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 保密协议

examples.en: The confidentiality clause covers code, data, and even the roadmap.
examples.zh: 保密条款覆盖代码、数据，甚至路线图。

situation.en: A confidentiality clause without a time limit is worth negotiating.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 保密条款

examples.en: Intellectual property rights in side projects are the clause to read first.
examples.zh: 副业项目的知识产权是最先要读的条款。

situation.en: The contract assigns intellectual property rights in everything built 'for the company'.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 知识产权

examples.en: Under work for hire, the company owns what you build on its time.
examples.zh: 按职务作品原则，你在公司时间里做的东西归公司所有。

situation.en: Work for hire usually covers job duties, not your weekend open source.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 职务作品（雇主付钱、成果归雇主）

examples.en: You assign ownership of deliverables, not of your pre-existing tools.
examples.zh: 你转让的是交付物的所有权，不是你原有工具的所有权。

situation.en: Check whether you assign ownership of inventions made outside working hours.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 转让所有权（把成果归属签给对方）

examples.en: A non-compete clause can ban you from your own industry for a year.
examples.zh: 竞业限制条款能让你一年内不能干自己的老本行。

situation.en: The non-compete clause names competitors so broadly it covers the whole market.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 竞业限制条款

examples.en: Non-solicitation stops you hiring your old teammates after you leave.
examples.zh: 禁止招揽条款阻止你离职后挖老队友。

situation.en: Non-solicitation usually lasts twelve months and covers clients as well.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 禁止挖角/禁止招揽条款

examples.en: At-will employment means either side can end it without a reason.
examples.zh: 自由雇佣意味着任何一方都可以无理由结束雇佣关系。

situation.en: At-will employment makes the notice period a courtesy, not a right.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 自由雇佣（双方可随时无理由解约，美国常见）

examples.en: The termination clause is the contract's fire exit: read it before signing.
examples.zh: 解约条款是合同的消防通道：签之前先读它。

situation.en: Under the termination clause, unused vacation converts to pay.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 解约条款

examples.en: Severance pay in the offer is one month, whatever the law requires beyond that aside.
examples.zh: 录用条件里的遣散费是一个月，法律另有要求的另说。

situation.en: Severance pay is often negotiable before you sign, never after.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 遣散费、离职补偿

examples.en: The probationary period is ninety days with a review at the midpoint.
examples.zh: 试用期是九十天，中间有一次评估。

situation.en: During the probationary period, the notice on both sides is one week.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 试用期

examples.en: Anything outside the scope of work needs a change order, not a favor.
examples.zh: 工作范围之外的事需要变更单，不需要人情。

situation.en: The scope of work lists deliverables, milestones, and what is excluded.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 工作范围（合同里界定要做什么）

examples.en: Deliverables are defined by acceptance tests, not by effort.
examples.zh: 交付物由验收标准界定，不由投入的工作量界定。

situation.en: Late deliverables trigger the fee in section six.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 交付物（合同要求交的东西）

examples.en: The payment terms say invoices are paid within thirty days.
examples.zh: 付款条款说发票在三十天内支付。

situation.en: For a first client, tighten the payment terms until trust exists.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 付款条款

examples.en: Net 30 means the clock starts when the invoice lands, not when work ends.
examples.zh: 30 天账期的意思是：时钟从发票送达时开始算，不是从活干完时算。

situation.en: The agreement says net 30, but their finance team pays on Fridays only.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 30 天账期（发票开出后 30 天内付款）

examples.en: A late payment fee of two percent a month concentrates minds wonderfully.
examples.zh: 每月百分之二的逾期付款滞纳金能奇妙地让人专注起来。

situation.en: Waiving the late payment fee once is kindness; twice is policy.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 逾期付款滞纳金

examples.en: The limitation of liability caps your exposure at the fees paid.
examples.zh: 责任限制把你的赔付敞口封顶在已收费用。

situation.en: Without a limitation of liability, one bug could cost more than the contract is worth.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 责任限制（赔付上限条款）

examples.en: Indemnification decides who pays when a stranger sues over your work.
examples.zh: 赔偿担保决定当陌生人因你的工作起诉时由谁买单。

situation.en: Read indemnification carefully: it is the clause that can outlive the fee.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 赔偿担保（替对方承担第三方索赔）

examples.en: Missing the deadline is a breach of contract only if time was of the essence.
examples.zh: 只有当时间被写成关键要素时，错过截止日期才算违约。

situation.en: A breach of contract needs notice and a cure period before termination.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 违约

examples.en: Non-payment past sixty days counts as a material breach in this agreement.
examples.zh: 在这份协议里，逾期付款超过六十天算重大违约。

situation.en: A material breach lets the other side walk away immediately.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 重大违约（严重到可直接解约的违约）

examples.en: The governing law is Delaware, which surprises nobody in this industry.
examples.zh: 适用法律是特拉华州法，这在行业里谁都不意外。

situation.en: Governing law matters most when everything else has already gone wrong.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 适用法律（合同按哪国/哪州法律解释）

examples.en: Jurisdiction decides whose courts hear the fight.
examples.zh: 管辖地决定这场官司去谁的法院打。

situation.en: Accepting a foreign jurisdiction means litigating far from home.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 管辖地（打官司去哪里的法院）

examples.en: The dispute resolution section prefers mediation before anyone sues.
examples.zh: 争议解决部分倾向于先调解、再谈起诉。

situation.en: Dispute resolution clauses hide in the back and rule the worst days.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 争议解决（出纠纷时的处理路径）

examples.en: Arbitration is private, faster, and usually final.
examples.zh: 仲裁是私下的、更快的，而且通常是终局的。

situation.en: The clause sends disputes to arbitration and waives the court route.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 仲裁（不上法庭、私下裁决）

examples.en: Force majeure excuses performance when the world intervenes.
examples.zh: 不可抗力在世界插手时免除履约责任。

situation.en: The force majeure list includes war, embargo, and infrastructure collapse.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 不可抗力

examples.en: The entire agreement clause erases every promise made in the interview.
examples.zh: 完整协议条款会抹掉面试时许下的一切承诺。

situation.en: Because of the entire agreement clause, get the remote-work promise in writing.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 完整协议（以本合同为准，口头承诺无效）

examples.en: An amendment needs both signatures, like the original.
examples.zh: 修正需要双方签字，和原件一样。

situation.en: Salary changes arrive as an amendment, not as an email, however friendly.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 修正、修订（对合同的正式修改）

examples.en: Approvals count only in writing under this agreement.
examples.zh: 按这份协议，批准只有以书面形式才算数。

situation.en: If it is not in writing, it is a rumor with good intentions.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 以书面形式（正式、留痕的）

examples.en: The signed offer letter is legally binding in most jurisdictions.
examples.zh: 签了字的录用信在大多数法域都具有法律约束力。

situation.en: A verbal yes is encouraging; a legally binding document is better.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 具有法律约束力的

examples.en: The effective date is the signing date, not the start date.
examples.zh: 生效日期是签字日期，不是入职日期。

situation.en: Confidentiality runs from the effective date, even before you start.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 生效日期

examples.en: The expiration date on the NDA is three years after disclosure.
examples.zh: 保密协议的到期日期是披露后三年。

situation.en: Diarize the expiration date of every restriction you sign.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 到期日期

examples.en: The contract will renew automatically unless either side objects in writing.
examples.zh: 除非任一方书面反对，否则合同将自动续期。

situation.en: Services you forgot renew automatically; contracts you forgot do the same.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 自动续期

examples.en: Either side may terminate for cause with immediate effect.
examples.zh: 任一方都可因故解约，立即生效。

situation.en: Fraud is the textbook reason to terminate for cause.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 因故解约（对方犯错时立即解约）

examples.en: You may terminate for convenience with thirty days' notice.
examples.zh: 你可以提前三十天通知，无因解约。

situation.en: Terminate for convenience is the clause that makes the contract honest.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 无因解约（不需要理由、提前通知即可）

examples.en: An independent contractor invoices monthly and files their own taxes.
examples.zh: 独立承包商每月开票、自己报税。

situation.en: Misclassifying an employee as an independent contractor is a legal risk for the company.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 独立承包商

examples.en: Tax withholding differs for employees and contractors in most countries.
examples.zh: 在大多数国家，雇员和承包商的代扣代缴税款是不同的。

situation.en: No tax withholding on contractor payments means you budget for the tax bill yourself.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 代扣代缴税款

examples.en: The benefits package matters more than the headline salary gap.
examples.zh: 福利包比表面上的薪水差距更重要。

situation.en: Contractors get no benefits package; price that into the rate.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 福利包（保险、假期等一揽子福利）

examples.en: Equity compensation is a lottery ticket with a vesting schedule.
examples.zh: 股权薪酬是一张带着兑现时间表的彩票。

situation.en: Ask how equity compensation is taxed in your country before valuing it.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 股权薪酬（期权/限制性股票）

examples.en: The vesting schedule spreads the grant over four years.
examples.zh: 兑现时间表把授予分摊到四年里。

situation.en: Read the vesting schedule for what happens when you leave early.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 兑现时间表（期权分期到手的安排）

examples.en: The cliff period is one year: leave at month eleven, keep nothing.
examples.zh: 悬崖期是一年：第十一个月走人，什么都留不下。

situation.en: A cliff period aligns incentives and terrifies job-hoppers, by design.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 悬崖期（期权满一年才首次到手的期限）

examples.en: A data processing agreement governs any personal data the work touches.
examples.zh: 数据处理协议管辖工作涉及的一切个人数据。

situation.en: European clients attach a data processing agreement almost by reflex.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 数据处理协议（处理个人数据的附属协议）

examples.en: You may not hand the work to a subcontractor without written consent.
examples.zh: 未经书面同意，你不能把工作交给分包商。

situation.en: The clause makes you liable for your subcontractor as for yourself.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 分包商、转包方

examples.en: A trade secret stays protected only while it stays secret.
examples.zh: 商业秘密只有保持秘密时才受保护。

situation.en: Customer lists and pricing models are the classic trade secret examples.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 商业秘密

examples.en: The moonlighting policy allows open source but bans competitor work.
examples.zh: 兼职政策允许开源，但禁止给竞争对手干活。

situation.en: Check the moonlighting policy before your side project earns its first dollar.
situation.zh: 你在读一份远程工作的合同，看到这个说法：

entries.zh: 兼职政策（公司对员工接私活的规定）
